recommendations.title: Add Redis
recommendations.rationale: APScheduler job store survives restarts; distributed lock prevents duplicate call_events writes; enables rate limiting across workers.

recommendations.title: Replace APScheduler with ARQ
recommendations.rationale: APScheduler 3.x is sync-first; ARQ is async-native, Redis-backed, and a natural fit once Redis is added. Retry visibility improves significantly.

recommendations.title: Add slowapi rate limiting
recommendations.rationale: SMS and call endpoints hit carrier rate limits; slowapi enforces per-client limits with one decorator and Redis backend.

recommendations.title: Add Prometheus + Grafana
recommendations.rationale: Call volume, SMS delivery rate, and webhook latency need dashboards; prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator adds this with minimal code.

recommendations.title: Add /health endpoint
recommendations.rationale: Required for Docker healthcheck and any future load balancer or k8s setup. Checks DB + Jambonz reachability.

recommendations.title: Add PgBouncer connection pooler
recommendations.rationale: PostgreSQL connection overhead becomes a bottleneck at scale; single docker-compose service, transparent to the app.

recommendations.title: Upgrade React 18 → 19
recommendations.rationale: React 19 is stable. Concurrent features and improved Suspense improve R3F performance. No breaking changes expected for this usage pattern.

recommendations.title: Add schemathesis API contract testing
recommendations.rationale: FastAPI auto-generates an OpenAPI schema; schemathesis fuzzes every endpoint against it for 500s, auth bypass, and unexpected response shapes — zero test authoring required to get coverage across all routes.

recommendations.title: Add bandit security linter
recommendations.rationale: Carameli handles API keys, HMAC secrets, and raw webhook payloads; bandit catches hardcoded secrets, shell injection, and insecure deserialization patterns before they reach production.

recommendations.title: Add pip-audit dependency vulnerability scanning
recommendations.rationale: The carrier and call engine dependencies (Telnyx SDK, httpx, cryptography) are high-value targets; pip-audit scans the lockfile against the OSV database and flags known CVEs.

recommendations.title: Add mypy static type checking
recommendations.rationale: The CarrierProvider / CallEngineProvider Protocol interfaces are the primary correctness boundary; mypy enforces that all provider implementations actually satisfy the Protocol without running the app.

recommendations.title: Add hypothesis property-based testing
recommendations.rationale: Phone number parsing, rate limit boundary conditions, and SMS payload validation are good candidates; hypothesis auto-generates edge cases that hand-written unit tests miss.

recommendations.title: Upgrade postgres image 16 → 18
recommendations.rationale: CLAUDE.md declares PostgreSQL 18 as the target DB, but docker-compose.yml pins postgres:16 — the mismatch means local dev diverges from the documented architecture.

recommendations.title: Add vitest for frontend unit tests
recommendations.rationale: The frontend has zero automated tests; vitest integrates directly with the existing Vite config and can test hooks and skin logic without a browser, closing the only untested layer in the stack.

recommendations.title: Add ruff Python linter/formatter
recommendations.rationale: The backend has no formatter or style linter; ruff replaces flake8+isort+pyupgrade in one fast binary and would pair naturally with the planned bandit and mypy additions.
